children.name: text
children: {br}The following attendances will be provided free of charge by MCLAREN where indicated. Where McLaren are not indicated then the subcontractor shall provide at no charge to McLaren.

children.name: text
children: Unless shown below as being provided by McLaren (MCL), all such items are to be provided by the Sub-Contractor at his cost. The items provided by MCL shall be limited to the period on site as set out in Appendix C of the Tender Review Meeting minutes. Ensure all provisions comply with MCL specific requirements.

Note: Prescription glasses do not constitute eye protection. Over glasses or prescription safety glasses will be a mandatory requirement.
